d:
Jan suraj ke pramukh prashant kishor ka ek vidiyo bihar men jabardast vayral ho raha hai. parti ke ek karyakram men prashant kishor ne mithila ke brahmanon ko nasihat di. unki manen to brahmanon ki rajnitik haisiyat islie kam huee kyonki unhonne bijepi ka sath dena shuru kar diya, jisse musalman dur chale gae. is bayan par paksh aur vipaksh donon taraph se rajnitik pratikriyaen aa rahi hain.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
